title: SeriesPromiseLedger Event
description: Append-only event log for cross-book narrative promises. Mirrors PromiseLedger but scoped to series-level arcs (e.g. overarching mystery, series antagonist reveal, slow-burn romantic arc spanning multiple books). Stub — Series Promise Ledger is V1 or early V2 priority per decisions.md 2026-05-15.

book_number.description: Book ordinal where this event occurred.

promise_id.description: Cross-book promise identifier. Consistent across all books in the series.

cross_book_arc_id.description: Optional arc ID grouping multiple series promises under a shared arc.

promise_type.description: Promise category (series-scoped extension of core/promise.schema.json types).

status.description: Current status of this cross-book promise.

opened_book.description: Book number where this promise was opened.

must_resolve_by_book.description: Latest book number by which this promise must be resolved.

description.description: Short summary of the series promise (e.g. 'The shadowy organization behind the heist is teased across books 1–3').
